name: Prevent Secret Commits
description: Blocks git commits that include .env files, credentials, or API key files
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block commits containing secrets or sensitive files
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git\s+(add|commit)'; then
  STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null)
  BLOCKED_PATTERNS=('.env' 'credentials' '.secret' 'api_key' '.pem' '.key')
  for pattern in "${BLOCKED_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
    if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qi "$pattern"; then
      echo "BLOCKED: Sensitive file detected in staged changes: $pattern"
      exit 2
    fi
  done
fi
exit 0
